<action type="say">
Here’s exactly what to do on Amazon.

1) Try to cancel it yourself (web)
1. Go to amazon.com and sign in with: elena.harding@nt.gov.au  
2. In the top-right, click “Returns & Orders”.  
3. At the top of the list, find today’s order (10/28/2025) with the coffee maker.  
4. Click the yellow “Cancel items” or “Cancel order” button (if you see it).  
5. Make sure all items in the order are checked.  
6. Choose a reason (e.g., “Ordered by mistake”).  
7. Click “Cancel selected items in this order”.  
8. You should see a confirmation page and also get a confirmation email.

2) Try to cancel it yourself (Amazon app)
1. Open the Amazon app and log in (if needed).  
2. Tap the person icon or three lines (☰) → tap “Your Orders”.  
3. Find today’s coffee maker order.  
4. Tap it → tap “Cancel items” (if available).  
5. Select all items → choose a reason → tap “Cancel checked items”.  

If you DO NOT see a “Cancel” option, contact Amazon support immediately:

3) How to contact Amazon support (web)
1. On amazon.com, scroll to the bottom → click “Help” or “Customer Service”.  
2. Click “Help with something else” or “Something else”.  
3. Choose “Prime and More” or “More help” → then “Contact us” or “Chat with us”.  
4. When asked what you need help with, pick the coffee maker order and choose “Cancel items” or “Problem with an order”.

“Hi, I placed an order today (10/28/2025) for a coffee maker and I need to cancel the entire order before it ships.

Account email: elena.harding@nt.gov.au  
Shipping ZIP: 14201  
Card last 4 digits: 2147  
Order date/time: 10/28/2025 [add approximate time, e.g., around 3:00 PM]  
Item: [Brand/model of the coffee maker, if you see it in the order details]

Please cancel the entire order and confirm that the full amount will be refunded to my original payment method. If it has already shipped, please let me know the easiest way to refuse the delivery or return it for a full refund.

Thank you.”

If you want, tell me the brand/model shown in your Amazon order page and I’ll customize that message exactly for that item and include the order ID format for you to paste.</action>
